name: Kinomino ~Cosplay Ken e Youkoso~
original_name: きのみの～コスプレ研へようこそ～
source:
Main character sews well from the childhood under influence of his clothes designer mother. One day cosplay club president learns about this skill and forces protagonist to help with making a costume. And protagonist feels affection towards club's girls who take on fancy dresses and are not yet spoiled by manga, animation and games.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-july-2006-bra-ban.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
受服装设计师母亲影响，主人公从小就擅长缝纫。一天，Cosplay研究会会长得知了他的本领，强迫他帮忙制作服装。面对换上华丽服饰、尚未被漫画、动画与游戏“污染”的研究会女孩们，主人公渐渐萌生了爱意。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-july-2006-bra-ban.html]vndbreview[/url]]
